destination.name: Wuzhen
destination.tagline: A canal town of stone bridges and wooden houses, built for strolling by day and by night
destination.description: Wuzhen is a water town in northern Zhejiang, laid out around narrow canals and split into two main quarters on opposite sides of a canal. The Eastern Quarter holds restored shops, temples and small museums, plus the former home of writer Mao Dun nearby. The larger Western Quarter is built around a network of narrow canals and can be crossed by boat-bus. Both are often crowded.
whyVisit: Stay overnight in a canal-side inn
Ride a boat through the water town
Visit small museums and old shops

goodToKnow.title: Two separate quarters
goodToKnow.detail: The Eastern and Western Quarters sit on opposite sides of a canal and are entered separately, so decide which to visit.

goodToKnow.title: Ride the boat-bus
goodToKnow.detail: A boat-bus takes visitors around the Western Quarter, the larger and more canal-based of the two.

goodToKnow.title: Mao Dun's home is close
goodToKnow.detail: Mao Dun's family residence is in the Northern Quarter, very close to the Eastern Quarter.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Best in {months}, when mild weather suits canal walks. June is the rainiest month.
